root_cause.text: The iavf driver failed to stop the PTP time caching worker before freeing adapter resources during reset or disable operations, creating a race condition that allowed the worker to access freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the worker introduced in commit 7c01dbfc8a1c5f "failed to stop it during reset or disable," causing `iavf_reset_task()` or `iavf_disable_vf()` to free resources while the worker runs; the patch adds `iavf_ptp_release(adapter)` calls in both functions to ensure synchronous cancellation.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The iavf driver failed to cancel the PTP time caching worker before freeing adapter resources in the `iavf_disable_vf()` and `iavf_reset_task()` functions because `iavf_ptp_release()` was omitted from these cleanup paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added PTP resource cleanup to the VF disable path to prevent resource leaks.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to iavf_ptp_release(adapter) within the iavf_disable_vf function.
intent_record.how: Ensures that Precision Time Protocol (PTP) resources are properly released when the virtual function is disabled, preventing resource leaks or stale hardware state.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a resource leak by adding missing PTP cleanup to the driver reset routine.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to iavf_ptp_release(adapter) within the iavf_reset_task function, placed after state transition and before freeing Tx/Rx rings.
intent_record.how: Ensures Precision Time Protocol (PTP) resources are explicitly released during the device reset sequence, preventing resource leaks or use-after-free errors when hardware descriptors are deallocated.
